# polygon-clipping 0.15.7

Unmodified UMD bundle vendored from the official pinned tag:
https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping/blob/v0.15.7/dist/polygon-clipping.umd.js

SHA-256: `de2bdc061b61d537f7d12f6519f46e35113f0f246b6a06293a08b615454946cf`

The bundle is used locally by Fence Studio's union worker, with no runtime CDN.
`LICENSE.md` preserves the upstream MIT license. The bundle includes splaytree
3.1.2 (MIT; `SPLAYTREE-LICENSE.md`) and a TypeScript helper with an Apache 2.0
notice (`APACHE-2.0.txt`). Original inline notices are retained unchanged.

Splaytree license source:
https://github.com/w8r/splay-tree/blob/v3.1.2/Readme.md#license

The bundle also includes robust-predicates (Unlicense), preserved in
`ROBUST-PREDICATES-LICENSE` from its official v3.0.2 tag:
https://github.com/mourner/robust-predicates/blob/v3.0.2/LICENSE
